comparison.objective: Replace a worn robot-gripper finger, refit its plate and place three M3 screws.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual part selection, bimanual plate holding, component exchange and repeated small-part hole alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Worn part binned, new finger and plate seated within millimetre tolerances, three screws placed, all parts retained and released still.
comparison.reason: Closest precision-maintenance neighbor, but its central ability is pick-place assembly of loose screws and parts. It does not test hammer/mandrel coordination, controlled fracture or recovery of newly released tangs from a cavity.
